question: So Mr. Cat doesn’t much like it when the crude content gets too deep?? I enjoying reading it quite a bit, too, but Mushoku Tensei has quite a bit of that; are you alright with it?? (note: Mushoku Tensei, literally Jobless Reincarnation, is a popular web novel on the same site that Re: Zero is published on)
answer: I’m not bothered by crude content in something I think of as ‘A work with that sort of thing’. I play erotic games, too. But, I don’t think of my work as ‘A work with that sort of thing’, and I, myself, don’t think of that as something that needs to be shown openly, so I dislike waving it around. Mushoku Tensei was giving off that sort of feeling from the start, so it’s fine. If there was a sudden change along the way and crude content suddenly became frequent, I think that would be no good.
